injuried.emotions: woman injuried and traped in car

dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?

dialogOption.emotions: [amused] A guy, speaks with some slang
dialogOption.texten: Whoa, dude, we have a situation here!
{WHAT HAPPENED?}Ok, what happened?
Eeeeerrm... you know, a car fell into the ground!
{ADDRESS?} Sir, what's your location?
It's at Columbus Avenue 246
It's at Oak street 135
It's at 7th street 89
{DESCRIBE THE ACCIDENT}Tell me what happened sir?
After the quake, the road just cracked and kinda split up. And the car just... it just fell there.
{IS THE CAR IN THE CRACK?}So the car is in one of the cracks in the road way?
It partially, like, slid into the hole.
{IS THE CAR RUNNING?} Is the car still running?
No, no... I mean, it was running but lady driving it stopped and turned it off when shaking started. I guess she was just panicked.
{HOW DEEP IS IT?} How deep is the hole the car is in?
Let me have a look... Well, I don't know, six to eight feet, maybe more.
{ANYONE IN THE CAR?}Is there anyone still in the car?
Ummm, Yes, a-a woman.
{GET DOWN AND HELP} Sir, if it's safe could you check the vehicle and see if the woman has any injuries.
OK, sure thing... [in distance] Hey hold this . . . . . . . . . pass me my phone! Thanks.
{CHECK IF DRIVER IS INJURED} Ok, I want you to check the driver and see if she has any injuries.
... Ohh man! She's not moving, I can see blood on the airbag . . . . . . . . . The door is blocked, boulder is blocking it dude! Damn rubble is everywhere!
{SMASH THE WINDOW} Sir here is what I want you to do. I want you have to find something heavy and smash the window to help her.
No way! I will get hurt. Send us some help now!
Ok, let's do this!!
{OPEN OTHER DOOR} Try to open any of the other car doors, maybe one on the other side, and help her.
There is so much stuff lying around her, the damn rubble is everywhere.
{YOU HAVE TO HELP HER!}Sir, please you have to help her.
Ok . . . . . . . . . Damn it!!! The car just moved! Crap I am trapped now!! Help me!
{HELP IS ON THE WAY} The emergency services are on the way, there will be there any minute. Keep calm.
{I'LL SEND HELP} I am sending the emergency services, please wait for them.
Better be quick, the tremors might start again!
{ASK OTHERS FOR HELP} Sir, is there anyone around you? Ask someone for help with the boulder blocking the door. Then take out the trapped woman.
I will . . . . Hey, Tony! Find someone and get down here. I need help! . . . . . . . . . I will need both hands to move this stuff.
{CHECK HER PULSE}Get her out of the car and out the hole on to level ground and check her pulse. If she has no pulse please call 911 again.
Ok, ok, I'll do it.
Are you there?

reportElement.texten: During earthquake car fell into chasm. Driver was inside a vehicle and unconscious.
Witness refused to break a car window to provide help. Emergency services were deployed.
Witness smashed the car window and provided help to injured woman.
Operator asked the witness to provide help in hazardous environment. This resulted in witness being trapped. Emergency services were deployed rapidly.
Operator provided remote instructions and together with witness and other bystanders they rescued injured woman.
